newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern boosts offer for Conrail.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern boosts offer for Conrail.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said on Friday it was raising its all-cash takeover offer for Conrail Inc to $110 a share from $100.
It said its new offer represented an 18 percent premium over a rival CSX Corp bid for Conrail.

On Wednesday Conrail and CSX announced they had revised their October merger pact, increasing the cash portion of the CSX bid. The new CSX offer values Conrail at about $93 a share, according to stock market sources.

Norfolk Southern said its offer, which it valued at about $10 billion, is superior to CSX's cash and stock deal since it is not contingent on regulatory approval and will provide immediate cash payment to Conrail shareholders.
"Our increased offer demonstrates our total commitment to this combination," Norfolk Southern Chairman David Goode said in a written statement.

"We are determined to take every step necessary to ensure that Conrail shareholders will have an opportunity to choose between our superior offer and CSX's coercive, two-tiered, front-end-loaded offer," Goode said.
